text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
together with Grass Wonder—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Twinkle Series has settled 
down, I thought it was time to fulfill the 
promise we made before.
choice_data_list:
Could this be that hot springs trip you 
won from the raffle?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Assuming it fits into Trainer's 
schedule... what do you think~?

Thinking it a great opportunity to soothe 
my built-up fatigue, I readily agreed 
without a second thought.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We've arrived, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The waters here are simple thermal 
springs, said to relieve fatigue, 
neuralgia, muscle pain, and shoulder 
stiffness~.
choice_data_list: Your research is spot-on, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The more you know beforehand, the more 
enjoyable a trip becomes, after all~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs in particular have been an 
integral part of our culture since the 
times of the Kojiki and Nihon Shoki—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I got curious, so I ended up researching 
all sorts of things♪

Impressed by her usual diligence, I passed 
through the inn's gate alongside Grass 
Wonder.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Phew, the water was just the right 
temperature~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My body is warmed to the core, and all the 
fatigue from the race seems completely 
gone♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like a waste to just head back 
to our rooms like this, so would you like 
to take a short walk?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It really is a beautiful starry 
sky~.
choice_data_list: It's quite a spectacular sight, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ The starry sky seen from the open-air 
bath was just so breathtaking—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping that I could gaze at it 
together with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"‘Among the countless stars that scatter 
like grains of sand, there shines one star 
turned toward me.’"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's a poem by Masaoka Shiki.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"‘Among the countless stars, like fine 
grains of sand, there is a star that 
shines just for me.’"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To me, I believe that star... is you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The path I walked was steep, with many 
walls to overcome... It was a journey of 
continuous hardship.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of all that, the reason I 
could achieve a result with no regrets is 
all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because you kept illuminating my path and 
watching over me with warmth—

"Just like the stars twinkling overhead, 
there are countless Umamusume aiming for 
the top."

Among them, there was a single radiance 
that caught my eye and wouldn't let go. 
That Umamusume was Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Guiding stars for each other, you say? 
Perhaps the world might call such a thing 
'destiny.'"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Is that an exaggeration, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"As long as they illuminate each other, 
they will surely never lose their way."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I can continue moving forward just as I 
always have, with an unyielding spirit of 
'No Retreat'.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No matter how steep the path may be— 
Trainer-san, I will walk it alongside you.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Grass Wonder 
and myself...
